and bread so much that he ate it constantly, and as it grew popular in London society circles, it also took on the
Earl’s name.
Of course, John Montagu (or rather, his nameless cook) was hardly the first person to think of putting
fillings between slices of bread. In fact, we know exactly where Montagu first got the idea for his creation.

inspiration from these when he sat at that card table.
